sources.label: BP 344: Accessibility Law — Anthropometric Reference Standards
sources.description: Provides accessibility-related dimensional requirements that reference standard anthropometric data for Filipino population.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XII — Minimum Clearance and Dimension Requirements
sources.description: Specifies minimum room dimensions, corridor widths, door/window clearances, and stair dimensions that inform furniture and space planning.

sources.label: Human Factors and Ergonomics Society — ANSI/HFES 100: Human Factors Engineering of Computer Workstations
sources.description: International ergonomic standard referenced for workstation design dimensions, seat height ranges, and clearance requirements.

sources.label: Furniture Design Reference: Standard Philippine Anthropometric Data (DOST-ITDI Studies)
sources.description: Published DOST studies on Philippine anthropometric measurements used as basis for local furniture and space design standards.
